texte.Description claire et exhaustive des ser: A clear and complete description of the services and functions provided, and whether subcontracting is permitted — with its conditions

texte.Description des niveaux de service, avec: A description of the service levels, with their updates and revisions

texte.Deux paragraphes portent le MÊME titre,: Two clauses carry the SAME title, « Requirements for the AI system », three numbers apart.
texte.Deux revues du même compte ou une second: Two reviews from the same account, or a second review that can see the first, do not make two independent verifications: they make one, and subparagraph #(#) is not met.
texte.Deux réviseurs mal formés ne valent pas: Two poorly trained reviewers are no better than one trained reviewer, and subparagraph #(#) requires both.

A public document of the French administration. The # means of compliance are not reproduced here.
texte.Documenter ce qui n'est PAS entièrement: Documenting what is NOT fully covered, justifying the measures chosen, and producing objective evidence that the requirement is satisfied.
texte.Documenter votre propre réaction aux rec: Documenting your own response to the recommendations made to your provider. That is what you will be held to account for, not the provider's behaviour.
texte.Documenté ailleurs dans le secteur, jama: Documented elsewhere in the sector, never happened here.
texte.Droit de suivi permanent des performance: The right to monitor performance on an ongoing basis: unrestricted rights of access, inspection and audit, alternative assurance levels, cooperation with on-site inspections, and details of their scope and frequency
texte.Droits de résiliation et délais de préav: Termination rights and minimum notice periods
texte.Du cycle de vie à la documentation techn: From the life cycle to the technical documentation: design, development, verification, validation, data.
texte.Déclarer le système génératif sans reten: Declaring the system generative without selecting a single risk amounts to saying that generation brings nothing — that is the answer an auditor will open first.
texte.Déclarer les thèmes de l'annexe A réelle: Declaring which Annex A themes are really in place sharpens the map — it is optional, and the block validates without it.
texte.Découper une activité en filiales ne fai: Splitting an activity across subsidiaries does not lower the assessment: it is consolidated.
texte.Défini, appliqué, porté par quelqu'un de: Defined, applied, owned by someone named.
texte.Déjà survenu ici, ou survient régulièrem: Has already happened here, or happens regularly in the sector.
texte.Délais de préavis et obligations de noti: Notice periods and reporting obligations, including of any development liable to affect the provider's capacity significantly
texte.Déléguée à une tierce partie (dérogation: Delegated to a third party (microenterprise derogation)
texte.Dépend d'un bloc précédent : ce qu'il de: Depends on an earlier block: what it would ask cannot be determined without it.

texte.Désigné en cours d'année : au plus tard: Designated during the year: by # December of that year at the latest.

texte.Elle est tenue par les autorités europée: It is kept by the European Supervisory Authorities, and is not in the text.
texte.Elle ne montre que ce que le registre co: It shows only what the register contains.
texte.Elle oblige à écrire ce qui est réversib: It forces you to write down what is reversible and what is not: a transfer gone out and an email sent cannot be taken back.
texte.Elle place le risque numérique devant le: It puts digital risk in front of the chief executive AND the business owners, and makes sure adequate financial, human or technical resources are allocated. The compliance-led approach and the risk-led approach are complementary and can be shared.
texte.Elle traite en lot ce que le simulateur: It handles as a batch what the simulator does one at a time.
texte.Elle vise aussi les produits déjà sur le: It also covers products already on the market.
texte.Empêcher l'exécution de ce qui n'a pas é: Preventing the execution of what was not intended, and detecting it when the prevention has failed.
texte.En place et appliqué, sans preuve systém: In place and applied, without systematic evidence.
texte.En place, appliqué, et démontrable sur p: In place, applied, and demonstrable on the documents.
texte.En place, appliqué, et montrable sur piè: In place, applied, and can be shown on the documents.
texte.Encadrer ce qui entre depuis l'extérieur: Framing what comes in from outside, where the physical security of the device is no longer guaranteed.
texte.Enregistrer les deux est ce qui permet,: Recording both is what makes it possible, six months later, to measure who was right and to adjust the system or the training.

texte.Estimation de la part de marché dans le: An estimate of the market share in the Union financial sector, and by type of financial entity, for the year of the request and the previous year
